name: context-term
description: Authoritative project terminology with scoped canonical slots and bounded lifecycle transitions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project-specific terms precise and scoped.
interface.longDescription: Captures project-specific terms and definitions as authoritative artifacts, recalls them only after an encountered terminology signal, and supersedes, deprecates, or annotates them through context-core approval and storage.
defaultPrompt: Require the exact installed and enabled context-core@context-plugins source, context-common/v2 protocol, and context-owner-descriptor/v2 feature before any non-static operation.
Claim only an explicitly project-specific term and definition; decline generic dictionary meanings and observation, decision, or assumption candidates.

Use search/read only after an exact term-encountered signal, never query every word automatically, compare both actual term and definition claims for same_claim, and never use IDs, hashes, fingerprints, or index metadata as semantic evidence.
Produce owner results and validation receipts only; delegate every repository write, index update, CAS check, lock, and apply to context-core after exact approval_digest approval.
